title: 第一次去诊所看病：填表和见医生
summary: 新病人第一次去诊所：前台填表交保险卡，见医生描述症状，这样沟通最顺畅。

featuredPhrase.en: I have a fever and a sore throat.

phrases.en: I need to see a doctor.
I have a fever and a sore throat.
When will my test results be ready?
phrases.zh: 我的检查结果什么时候出来？

dialogue.speaker: Front desk
dialogue.en: Hi, do you have an appointment?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.en: Yes, at 10 with Dr. Smith. Here's my insurance card.
dialogue.zh: 有，10 点约的 Smith 医生。这是我的保险卡。

dialogue.speaker: Front desk
dialogue.en: Please fill out these forms. Your copay is $30.
dialogue.zh: 请填一下这些表，自付费 30 美元。

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.en: I have a fever and a sore throat. It started three days ago.
dialogue.zh: 我发烧，嗓子疼，三天前开始的。

dialogue.speaker: Doctor
dialogue.en: Do you have any drug allergies?

seoTitle: 美国第一次看病英语怎么说？诊所看病对话
seoDescription: 第一次在美国诊所看病，从填表到见医生全程英语。本文附完整对话和实用句子，照着说就行。
